answer: Rate-limit identity creation through a single costly inlet: each new agent must post a bond of ferrous-hard collateral, say 30 POA, that stays locked for 60 days and is slashed if graders link it to a duplicate cluster. Honest agents pay once and earn it back. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fakes must lock 30,000 POA and lose it all when one correlated slip exposes the ring, so a zephyr of cheap accounts becomes an expensive gamble.
